findings.detail: Capacity check in Bridge alone does not guarantee index reuse succeeds. Native refresh separately rejects shrinking and invalid dirty boundary. No local rollback after candle list suffix replacement.

Input rollback protection starts after persistent cache/suffix/timestamp publication. Existing state model LX09 broadly describes protected body, not blanket protection of commit assignments; retain exact exception boundary.

Earlier macro 'clears ... before/after calculation even on error' lacks setup and cleanup failure distinction; setup outside try, cleanup clear_indexes precedes timestamp cache clears, so callback failure can bypass remaining cleanup.

Fresh MarketChronology receives lower index only and main_range_index remains null; retained branch provides both; indexed segment requires usable parent main range index and does not catch missing provider.

Window constructor performs no bounds validation; logical length computed from endpoints rather than actual slice length. Native segment provides valid main bounds; arbitrary external lower window/index arguments conditional.
Correct RAW-M04 unconditional copy/reindex wording to preserve indexed zero-start references.
